notes.title: The classic low-poly version of Treeker: The Lost Glasses is back!
notes.notes:
The classic version of Treeker: The Lost Glasses released in 2015 is now available once again. The game was replaced by the remake version in 2019, and it's now back with improvements to visuals, UI and a few puzzle adjustments.

The files for both versions are included when you install or update the game from now on. Launch the game and select which version you want to play.

notes.title: Update Version 2.1.1 - Hotfix
notes.notes: Fixed an issue that prevented UI buttons (pause menu) from reading mouse input in certain scenes.

notes.title: Update Version 2.1 Patch Notes
Rework update coming soon
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Treeker: The Lost Glasses was released in 2015 and it's been a long time since any news or updates. I'm now working on a complete rework to the game and I'd like to share a few images.

The update will be available when it's ready (no expected date yet), and players who already own the game will receive the update normally on Steam. The current version of the game will be replaced and will no longer exist.
